content.short: Trezor is a password-protected hardware wallet.
content.description: Trezor is a mobile hardware wallet with two models: Model T (the advanced option) and Model One. Its open-source designs allow security to be publicly audited and improved by the community. The device uses a user-defined PIN up to 50 digits long and can connect to the internet through the Trezor Suite app or via popular third-party wallets like MetaMask. This arrangement emphasizes verifiable security for managing crypto assets.
